questions.question: A landmark event during the Extremist Phase was the formation of a league that demanded self-governance within the British Empire. Which one of the following leader was instrumental in founding the Home Rule League in 1916?
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'D' (Bal Gangadhar Tilak) है।

questions.question: Why were tax rates reduced during the reform period 1991?
options: To increase import duties and reduce export duty
To make tax collection easier and reduce evasion
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'B' (To increase import duties and reduce export duty) है।

questions.question: The Zimmermann Plan is associated with:​
options: A French initiative to divide Bengal and avenge the plassey loss
A British strategy to suppress Indian revolutionaries and nationalists
An American plan to help India fight the British colonialists
A German proposal to support Indian independence during World War I
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'D' (A German proposal to support Indian independence during World War I) है।

questions.question: Article 29 ‘Protection of interests of minorities’ comes under which of the following rights, as per Constitution of India?
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'B' (Cultural and Educational Rights) है।

questions.question: What is the theme for World Wildlife Day 2025?
options: Wildlife Conservation Finance: Investing in People and Planet
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'B' (Wildlife Conservation Finance: Investing in People and Planet) है।

questions.question: During the southwest monsoon, the Arabian Sea branch first strikes which of the following region of India?
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'A' (Kerala coast) है।

questions.question: What is the name of one of the two advanced 32-bit microprocessors developed by Indian Space Research Organization (ISRO) for space missions in March 2025?
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'A' (Kalpana 3201) है।

questions.question: A person of Indian origin is eligible for registration as a citizen of India under Section 5(1)(a) if they have been ordinarily resident in India for:
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'A' (Seven years) है।

questions.question: Which of the following statements about the 1857 revolt is NOT true?a. Mangal Pandey. stationed at Barrackpore. attacked his British officers on 29 March 1857.b. Bakht Khan had led the revolt of the soldiers at Lucknow.c. Nana Saheb and Tantya Tope had led the revolt at Kanpur.d. The Begum of Awadh had led the revolt at Lucknow.

questions.question: If a wave travels from a solid into a gas and continues to propagate, which component(s) of the original wave is/are most likely to persist?
options: Both transverse and longitudinal components equally
